newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 4.

text.p: Following were the leading stories in Sri Lankan newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga of the ruling People's Alliance (PA) and main opposition United National Party (UNP) leader Ranil Wickremesinghe agree to common front to solve ethnic war.
Industrial Development Minister C.V. Gooneratne calls for electricity conservation, despite better power generation this year due to additional thermal power.
President Kumaratunga and UNP leader Ranil Wickremesinghe to adopt bipartisan approach in finding solution to ethnic strife.
Central Bank says no cause for concern over stability of the commercial bank under investigation by Customs Department regarding alleged foreign exchange fraud.
Chandrika-Ranil join hands in common front for solving ethnic issue.
Chandrika and Ranil agree to common approach in solving ethnic issue.
Historic agreement between two main political parties to present common front in solving ethnic crisis.
Repairs to northern Jaffna library to begin on April 10.
